messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area is the '3-4-6' arrangement, consisting of 3 points on one edge, 4 points on the opposite edge, and 6 interior points at intersections of diagonals connecting corresponding edge points, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/72. Any configuration of 13 distinct points in the unit square must contain a triple forming a triangle of area at most 1/72, and this bound is uniquely attained (up to affine symmetries of the square) by the 3-4-6 construction."}
